<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root alias_model_name="simple_greeting_model"
      chinese_name="简单问候模型"
      english_name="Simple Greeting Model"
      name="simple-greeting-model"
      cfg_mask_china_mobile="false"
      data_service="sqlite"
      org="doublechaintech"
      _module_key="root">
  
  <!-- You can use _include to split the project across multiple files (if you have many objects) -->
  <!-- <_include file="operations.xml" /> -->
  
  <Greeting _name="Greeting"
            _module="Core"
            _module_key="core"
            message="Hello, World!"
            language="English"
            create_time="createTime()"
            update_time="updateTime()"/>
            
  <GreetingType _name="GreetingType"
                _module="Core"
                _module_key="core"
                type="Formal"
                description="Standard formal greeting"
                create_time="createTime()"
                update_time="updateTime()"/>
</root>
